schedule_is: optimistic target subject to 2026-10-04 capacity checkpoint, not a committed estimate

items.title: Stripe cancellation on instance/last-admin deletion
items.closure_scenario: Delete a paying tenant directly and through its last administrator; cancellation obligation survives SQL cascade, retries crash/outage/late webhook, and sandbox subscription reaches terminal state.

items.title: SCIM active-SSO, verified-domain and operator-email gates
items.closure_scenario: Reject provisioning without active SSO/verified domain and for foreign/operator emails; disable/delete revokes connection-bound tokens, including concurrent mutation.

items.title: SCIM deactivation of nonlast administrators
items.closure_scenario: Deactivate a managed nonlast admin and revoke all sessions/MCP grants; simultaneous removals cannot eliminate the last administrative authority.

items.title: SCIM member/invitation adoption, UPN/email distinction, externalId filtering, name/email PATCH, retained string-active payloads
items.closure_scenario: Replay retained member/invite adoption, separate UPN/email, externalId filter, profile PATCH/PUT, rename and boolean/string-active cases; foreign identities cannot be adopted.

items.title: Controlled OIDC preferred_username/SCIM-UPN fallback
items.closure_scenario: A signed allowed UPN-only IdP identity follows the agreed verified-domain/SCIM mapping contract; issuer/nonce/state/signature and ownership failures remain denied.

items.title: Purchase browser pagination/search/sort and adjustment event rows
items.closure_scenario: Traverse more than 1000 same-timestamp sale/refund/reversal/cancellation rows with stable scoped pagination, filtering, order and verified/reported provenance.

items.title: Product-level revenue tables
items.closure_scenario: Two-product/two-platform fixtures reconcile signed revenue, units, repeat buyers and defined product ARPU/ARPPU with stable pagination and exact currency units.

items.title: Audit actor snapshots, before/after changes, outcome, request context, failed-login records and operational chain verification
items.closure_scenario: Actor rename/deletion preserves snapshots; known failed login and redacted old/new request-context records exist; mixed-version chains verify and detect tampering without rewriting old hashes.

items.title: Tenant credential onboarding/rotation for SSO, push and stores; APNs certificate mode
items.closure_scenario: For SSO, FCM/APNs including certificate mode, and Apple/Google stores: tenant admin create/redacted-read/rotate/revoke works, wrong-tenant/SSRF/invalid file denied, in-flight version behavior and real provider flows verified.
items.package_dependency_note: E8 audit storage/verifier foundation must precede K1 credential mutations; complete E8 request coverage can follow in week9.

items.title: Automatic IP-to-country/city enrichment and MMDB loading
items.closure_scenario: Deterministic MMDB IPv4/IPv6 and trusted-proxy fixtures yield identical canonical location in event/outbox; missing/corrupt database policy and frozen duplicate replay work.

items.title: Applying saved screen aliases and retained screen-name fallbacks
items.closure_scenario: Saved aliases apply across event property, visitor attribute and event-name fallback; routed event/session fields and outbox agree; later alias changes do not alter replay.

items.title: Device UA-to-OS/version and timezone propagation into events
items.closure_scenario: Correct originating device UA/OS/version/timezone reaches event/outbox without manually supplying derived event fields; project/device ownership and unknown cases remain correct.

items.title: Dashboard inviter/referral aggregate semantics
items.closure_scenario: Independent inviter/invitee/own activity, alias, platform and sale/refund fixture differentiates own and referral list/detail totals.

items.title: Visitor metric pagination, metric/identity sort/search, revenue hydration and rich detail
items.closure_scenario: More than 200 metric rows traverse without gaps/duplicates under sort ties and scoped cursors; identity search, signed revenue and own/referral detail match fixture.

items.title: Merge-aware unique visitors in warehouse analytics
items.closure_scenario: Basic customer analytics preserves all-event semantics but resolves canonical identities after published/pending/chained/concurrent merges under both provider configurations; direct provider-arrival checks remain separate.

items.title: Retained link CSV counters
items.closure_scenario: Link CSV contains and reconciles reinstall/reactivation/time-spent plus existing counters/metadata; retry/page/expiry and authorization behavior remains correct.

items.title: Range-sensitive usage CSV, daily active users and empty-period fill
items.closure_scenario: Partial-month fixture excludes outside-range activity; daily/monthly unique counts, zero-fill, timezone and retention boundaries are explicit and reconcile.

items.title: Expired migration negative-cache pruning
items.closure_scenario: Bounded cleanup removes only expired negative/transient migration cache after grace; fresh/resolved entries and concurrent successful refresh survive.

items.title: Runtime table-data deletion grant
items.closure_scenario: Actual Terraform runtime principal can publish/query and delete project rows while another tenant remains; denied deletion preserves local source/retries and succeeds after permission restoration.

items.title: Routed SDK support for raw Play Install Referrer and bare migration slug
items.closure_scenario: Routed native/migrated URL, encoded Play referrer, bare slug and permitted custom scheme resolve exact expected data/attribution; malformed/foreign-project cases denied.

items.title: MCP rich link/campaign search delegation
items.closure_scenario: Management, MCP REST and JSON-RPC searches return identical filtered entity/metric sets and stable pages; read scopes and token/project boundaries remain enforced.

items.title: Uploaded link images and domain branding attachments
items.closure_scenario: Dashboard/SDK/quick-link/domain image upload-bind-render-replace-remove works; public serving exposes only published images; provider failures/concurrency/tenant deletion leave correct durable cleanup.

items.title: Tokenless clipboard project-activity check
items.closure_scenario: Tokenless status is false initially, true after eligible copy-enabled activity and false after TTL; project isolation and optional token consume/replay remain correct on real client.

items.title: Mandatory SDK app/platform configuration gate
items.closure_scenario: Missing/unconfigured/disabled/wrong platform-identifier-origin combinations reject before side effects; valid mobile/web and separate server-SDK paths remain usable.

items.title: Self-hosted flag automatically closing registration
items.closure_scenario: Self-hosted public signup is denied through both aliases while authorized invitations work; independent disable flag and SaaS policy combinations covered.

items.title: Retained per-IP request throttles
items.closure_scenario: Two app instances share source-IP policy; rotating identities and spoofed forwarding cannot bypass it; separate sources, IPv6, expiry, 429/retry behavior and database failure policy covered.

items.title: OpenTelemetry/OTLP trace integration and metrics instrumentation
items.closure_scenario: Local OTLP collector receives correlated request/database/provider/worker spans and required bounded-cardinality metrics; redaction and collector-outage behavior verified.

items.title: Deep dependency diagnostics and dedicated diagnostics-key contract
items.closure_scenario: Independent bounded dependency probes report current isolated failures; monitor credentials cannot invoke repairs; liveness/readiness policy remains explicit.

items.title: Redis TLS client features/configuration
items.closure_scenario: Real authenticated TLS Redis fixture verifies trusted CA/hostname, rejects wrong trust, reconnects and reports malformed config; PostgreSQL queued events progress during Redis outage.

items.title: Atomic initial-member provisioning
items.closure_scenario: Mixed new/existing initial members and paired projects commit atomically; invalid member/forbidden role rolls back invites/mail; defined no-SMTP self-hosted links work.

items.title: Renaming paired projects with an instance
items.closure_scenario: Instance and its paired production/test projects rename atomically with defined custom-name rule and audit before/after; rollback leaves all original names.
items.acceptance_note: Rename behavior implemented week7; final audit before/after assertions await E8 coverage in week9.

items.title: Rails data conversion and legacy archive recovery
items.closure_scenario: After actual legacy inventory: stable source-ID mapping, resumable/idempotent event/archive import, exact tenant/financial reconciliation and rehearsed cutover/rollback. Not needed for fresh native schema installation.

target_week_semantics: Implementation windows at lower-bound estimates; final closure also depends on declared acceptance prerequisites and required live verification.
